in_sanskrit.name: Alagu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace, Blessing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alagu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Alagu is a Sanskrit name derived from the Tamil word 'alagam' which means 'God's Grace' or 'Blessing'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Murugan and is believed to bring prosperity, strength, and protection.
